title_en: Fall 2026 National Work-Study Scholarship: Winter Vacation Intensive Work Selection Schedule
summary: Undergraduate students currently enrolled who applied for the general type of the National Work-Study Scholarship for Fall 2026 may apply for the winter vacation intensive work program, which runs from 1 January to 14 February 2027 and pays 12,790 won per hour. To take part, students must apply for their preferred workplaces themselves on the Korea Student Aid Foundation (KOSAF) website or mobile app between 9:00 on 30 October 2026 and 18:00 on 12 November 2026. The Foundation will announce the final selection results on 14 December 2026.
applies_to: Undergraduate students currently enrolled who applied for the general type (일반유형) of the National Work-Study Scholarship for Fall 2026. Participation is voluntary, for interested students. However, those who wish to take part must apply for preferred workplaces (희망근로지 신청). About 20 students will be selected.

conditions: Only undergraduate students currently enrolled who applied for the general type of the Fall 2026 National Work-Study Scholarship are eligible.
You cannot take part unless you apply for preferred workplaces within the application period; this application is required.
You must submit the preferred workplace application yourself on the KOSAF website or mobile app.
You may choose up to 5 off-campus workplaces, and you will be automatically matched to one of them.
Candidates are selected according to the university's own selection criteria (see the attachment).
Work is limited to a maximum of 8 hours per day and 40 hours per week.
The scholarship is paid at 12,790 won per hour.
The schedule may change depending on the Foundation's and the university's academic calendars.
steps: Read the attached document on the university's own selection criteria for the Fall 2026 National Work-Study Scholarship (winter vacation intensive work). Its contents were not read for this translation.

Between 9:00 on 30 October 2026 and 18:00 on 12 November 2026, apply for your preferred workplaces yourself on the KOSAF website or mobile app: [Menu (메뉴)] > [Scholarships (장학금)] > [National Work-Study Scholarship (국가근로장학금)] > [Work-Study Management (근로장학관리)] > [Preferred Workplace Application (희망근로지 신청)]. Choose up to 5 off-campus workplaces.
If you are a selection candidate, confirm your final willingness to work when your college asks. The college completes this by 9 December 2026.
Check the final selection results published by KOSAF on 14 December 2026.
translation:
Title: Selection Schedule for the 2026 National Work-Study Scholarship Winter Vacation Intensive Work

We announce the selection schedule for the 2026 National Work-Study Scholarship winter vacation intensive work program. Interested students are asked to apply.

A. Overview of the Winter Vacation Intensive Work Program
• (Eligibility) Undergraduate students currently enrolled who applied for the general type (일반유형) of the National Work-Study Scholarship for Fall 2026
• (Work period) 1 January 2027 (Fri) to 14 February 2027 (Sun)
• (Workplace) Automatically matched from among the off-campus workplaces (up to 5) selected during the preferred workplace application period
• (Number selected) About 20 students
• (Working hours) Up to 8 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week
• (Scholarship) 12,790 won per hour

B. How to Participate
- Preferred workplace application (required): 30 October 2026 (Fri), 9:00 to 12 November 2026 (Thu), 18:00
※ Students must apply themselves on the Korea Student Aid Foundation website or mobile app.
• [Menu (메뉴)] > [Scholarships (장학금)] > [National Work-Study Scholarship (국가근로장학금)] > [Work-Study Management (근로장학관리)] > [Preferred Workplace Application (희망근로지 신청)]

C. Selection Schedule
1) (Foundation) Matching of workplaces and scholarship students, and confirmation of the priority recommendation list: 23 November 2026 (Mon)
2) (University headquarters) Confirmation of selection candidates from the priority recommendation list according to the university's own selection criteria: 4 December 2026 (Fri)
3) (College) Final confirmation of each student's willingness to work, then recommendation of National Work-Study scholarship students and registration in the system: by 9 December 2026 (Wed)
4) (University headquarters) Confirmation of final selected students: by 11 December 2026 (Fri)
5) (Foundation) Publication of final selection results: 14 December 2026 (Mon)
※ The schedule above may change depending on the Foundation's and the university's academic calendars.

Attachment: Seoul National University's own selection criteria for the Fall 2026 National Work-Study Scholarship, 1 copy.
